before.scope: Preview rejection, supplied-preview rejection and post-staging cap rejection leave files without rollback

limitations: Native audit overrides preview production to exercise failure/retention branches; codec itself verified separately
Sync rejection uses an in-memory fixture store and throwing sync function, not a cloud/offline durability test
Android rollback protocol not yet run natively
Filesystem refusal of rollback deletion is reported; no durable per-save orphan retry journal added
